description: Refactor step F1, class A (docs/plans/codebase-refactor.md §6.5): the declarations of src/api/client.ts move to api/http.ts (the axios instance, both interceptors, uploadConfig, API_BASE_URL, saveBlob, downloadBlob), api/types/<area>.ts (the types) and api/<area>.ts (the xxxAPI objects and the other values), and client.ts becomes a barrel with the same exports. Preview with: node frontend/scripts/tsdeclmove.mjs -n --spec frontend/scripts/specs/F1.json
